card.name: Step-by-step hand and body positioning instructions
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words (comma, dash, "and", "by", "then") right before the next physical action in a how-to instruction, such as placing, gripping, releasing or stepping.

modes.label: Body movement steps
modes.description: Linking word in directions about how to position or move the body or a limb.
modes.example: I then<< step>> over the bow with my right leg.

modes.label: Device handling steps
modes.description: Comma or "by" after a device action such as priming or expelling air, before the next hand action.
modes.example: To prime AIRSUPRA<<,>> release 4 sprays into the air

card.writes: It promotes words for placing and grabbing, such as putting, placing and grab, so the next action is a hand-placement verb.
card.plain: It fires in step-by-step directions just before the text says to put, place or grab something with a hand.
